name: shorthop
description: A personal URL shortener on one Cloudflare Worker: edge redirects, click analytics, a private admin.
author: Jan Tegze (https://jantegze.com)

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The admin password, at least 9 characters. Use a long random one (a password manager can make one): without Cloudflare Access, it alone protects the admin at `/_admin`. Change it later under the Worker's **Settings → Variables and Secrets**.

LINKS.description: KV namespace holding the published links, read on every redirect.

DB.description: D1 database: links, history, daily statistics, settings. Its migrations run on every deploy.

CLICKS.description: Analytics Engine dataset with one data point per click. To read it, add `CF_ACCOUNT_ID` and a `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` secret later ([docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/jntegz/shorthop/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#analytics)).

CLICK_CAPS.description: Durable Object counting clicks exactly, used only by links with a click limit.

scripts.deploy: tsx scripts/setup/check-deploy.ts && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: tsx scripts/setup/wrangler-local.ts d1 migrations apply DB --local
